message: Merged coordination-only main, created seven isolated canonical project branches from exact audited tree SHAs, protected old mixed-main PRs, and published the branch supersession registry.

predictive-survival-26-1-2.source: verified contingency tree formerly on main

data.structural_verification: Each canonical branch was re-read after creation and contains exactly one projects/* entry with the exact expected tree SHA; each has only shared workspace workflows plus its own project workflow.

source_ci.medusa: PR #16 exact source head: Medusa CI success and workspace validation success
source_ci.fallen_knight: PR #17 exact source head: workspace validation success; project CI failure from pre-existing WIP contract/runtime failures, not altered by cleanup
source_ci.crystal_v3: PR #24 exact source head: workspace validation success; project CI failure with 3 project tests failing, not altered by cleanup

data.speedbridge: Legacy artifact/patch lineage retained because repository does not contain an honest complete current source tree to transplant safely.
data.branch_deletion: Connected GitHub tooling and available plugins expose no branch/ref deletion action; old refs are classified in docs/protocols/branch-supersession-2026-08-24.md and are noncanonical, but were not destructively rewritten.
